scripts.android:build: JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21}" PATH="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21}/bin:$PATH" npx tauri android build -d -t aarch64 --apk true --aab false
scripts.android:build:aab: JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21}" PATH="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21}/bin:$PATH" npx tauri android build -d -t aarch64 --apk false --aab true
scripts.android:build:all: JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21}" PATH="${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21}/bin:$PATH" npx tauri android build -d -t aarch64 --apk true --aab true
scripts.android:emu:boot: ANDROID_AVD="${ANDROID_AVD:-MobileAI_API36_PixelTablet}"; if adb -e get-state >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Android emulator already running"; exit 0; fi; echo "Booting Android emulator: $ANDROID_AVD"; (emulator -avd "$ANDROID_AVD" -netdelay none -netspeed full -no-snapshot-save -no-audio -no-boot-anim >/dev/null 2>&1 &) && adb -e wait-for-device && (until adb -e shell getprop sys.boot_completed | grep -m 1 "1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done) && echo "Emulator booted"
scripts.android:emu:install: ANDROID_PKG="${ANDROID_PKG:-com.ai.tauri_ai}"; APK_PATH="${APK_PATH:-src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/debug/app-universal-debug.apk}"; npm run android:emu:boot && npm run android:build && if [ ! -f "$APK_PATH" ]; then echo "Missing APK: $APK_PATH"; exit 1; fi; echo "Installing APK: $APK_PATH"; adb -e install -r -d "$APK_PATH" && ANDROID_PKG="$ANDROID_PKG" npm run android:emu:sync-config
scripts.android:emu:sync-config: ANDROID_PKG="${ANDROID_PKG:-com.ai.tauri_ai}"; LEGACY="$HOME/.tauriai/config.json"; CANON="$HOME/.tauri-ai/config.json"; SRC="$LEGACY"; if [ ! -f "$SRC" ]; then SRC="$CANON"; fi; if [ ! -f "$SRC" ]; then echo "Missing config:"; echo "- $LEGACY"; echo "- $CANON"; exit 1; fi; echo "Syncing config: $SRC"; adb -e push "$SRC" /data/local/tmp/tauriai_config.json >/dev/null; (adb -e shell am start -n "$ANDROID_PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); sleep 2; TARGET=$(adb -e shell run-as "$ANDROID_PKG" find . -type f -name config.json 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | tr -d '\r'); if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then echo "No config.json found inside app data; fallback to files/config.json"; TARGET="files/config.json"; adb -e shell run-as "$ANDROID_PKG" mkdir -p files >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; adb -e shell run-as "$ANDROID_PKG" cp /data/local/tmp/tauriai_config.json "$TARGET"; echo "Copied to $TARGET"; (adb -e shell am force-stop "$ANDROID_PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); adb -e shell am start -n "$ANDROID_PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null 2>&1
scripts.ios:sim:boot: IOS_SIM_DEVICE="${IOS_SIM_DEVICE:-iPhone 17}" && open -a Simulator && (xcrun simctl boot "$IOS_SIM_DEVICE" || true) && xcrun simctl bootstatus "$IOS_SIM_DEVICE" -b
scripts.ios:sim:install: IOS_SIM_DEVICE="${IOS_SIM_DEVICE:-iPhone 17}" && npm run ios:sim:boot && (rm -r src-tauri/gen/apple/build/arm64-sim/tauri-ai.app 2>/dev/null || true) && (rm -r src-tauri/gen/apple/build/tauri-ai_iOS.xcarchive 2>/dev/null || true) && npm run ios:sim:build && xcrun simctl install "$IOS_SIM_DEVICE" "src-tauri/gen/apple/build/arm64-sim/tauri-ai.app" && IOS_SIM_DEVICE="$IOS_SIM_DEVICE" npm run ios:sim:sync-config
scripts.ios:sim:sync-config: IOS_SIM_DEVICE="${IOS_SIM_DEVICE:-iPhone 17}"; LEGACY="$HOME/.tauriai/config.json"; CANON="$HOME/.tauri-ai/config.json"; SRC="$LEGACY"; if [ ! -f "$SRC" ]; then SRC="$CANON"; fi; if [ ! -f "$SRC" ]; then echo "Missing config:"; echo "- $LEGACY"; echo "- $CANON"; exit 1; fi; echo "Syncing config: $SRC"; DATA_DIR=$(xcrun simctl get_app_container "$IOS_SIM_DEVICE" com.ai.tauri-ai data); DEST_DIR_HOME="$DATA_DIR/.tauri-ai"; DEST_DIR_AS="$DATA_DIR/Library/Application Support/com.ai.tauri-ai"; mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR_HOME"; mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR_AS"; cp "$SRC" "$DEST_DIR_HOME/config.json"; cp "$SRC" "$DEST_DIR_AS/config.json"; echo "Copied to:"; echo "- $DEST_DIR_HOME/config.json"; echo "- $DEST_DIR_AS/config.json"; (xcrun simctl terminate "$IOS_SIM_DEVICE" com.ai.tauri-ai 2>/dev/null || true); xcrun simctl launch "$IOS_SIM_DEVICE" com.ai.tauri-ai
